nodes.text: Reserve the vendor’s listed 75 gold for Web Pet Leash; confirm the actual price and discounts when the merchant opens.

recovery.text: The displayed vendor offer is authoritative. Do not automatically buy or reserve the same gold for another planned purchase.

nodes.text: Enter City of Threads on Normal, or choose its follower-dungeon queue when offered. The entrance is in Azj-Kahet.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Defeat Orator Krix’vizk in the first plaza. Stay close enough for Chains of Oppression, avoid the Terrorize frontal, and move him out of Lingering Influence after Vociferous Indoctrination. Then continue southeast outside sentries’ detection circles toward Fangs of the Queen.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Before proceeding past the second boss area, take the right-hand stairs/eastern side to Fliq’ri, Mistress of Minions.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Approach the guarding sentry, move through it to aim its frontal away, then open Fliq’ri and buy Web Pet Leash yourself before the guard ejects you. Another player can distract the sentry instead.

recovery.text: If teleported away, return and reposition before retrying; the guard interaction is expected. Check the exact merchant, price and bag space. No purchase occurs merely because the vendor window opened.

nodes.writtenDestination: City of Threads: after Orator Krix’vizk, cross southeast outside sentry detection circles. Before Fangs of the Queen, take the right/eastern stairs to Fliq’ri and her guarding sentry.

nodes.text: Use Web Pet Leash from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
